mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor force participation (PAYEMS) is rising and unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling occurs in more than 40% of instances where returns are negative, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeds 2% annualized, it signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate > 2% annualized and 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it indicates strong economic activity and corporate demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as central banks may tighten policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5% annualized and 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) is negative, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as lower real rates boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: The real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) is negative and 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% and 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances over the last 5 years, or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
